# Battles, Check For Updates, What's New

This update adds a new category to reports called "Battles". These are calculated during the report generation to use for finding Fleet Doctrines and a few other things. They look for killmails in the same system within a rolling 15 minute window, or killmails with the same people on them in that same window in other systems.

The Battles tab shows an overview of all battles with 10 or more participants (both sides combined) - this is NOT a battle report tool, this is only an overview of potential battles. It can make mistakes. It has no idea who was on what side. It does however link to popular BR tools to generate at least a starter battle report. You may need to tweak those for better information.

The Generate Report functionality will show the 10 most recent "battles" and 10 largest, with links to the popular sites as well for distribution to your FC and Leadership.

We renamed Top Members to avoid confusion - it's now Top Pilots.

We cleaned up the release package - the two json files aren't necessary at this time (maybe in the future - they're partially for a planned mini release system that doesn't require a whole new exe when the SDE updates).

This update also adds a check system for new updates, and a What's New popup when a new update is installed.
